title: STAC Zarr Convention
description: Schema for STAC Zarr convention - embedding or referencing STAC objects in Zarr group metadata with relative asset URLs

node_type.description: Type of Zarr node - must be 'group' for STAC convention

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and STAC objects

conventionMetadata.description: STAC convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

description.const: STAC convention for embedding or referencing STAC objects in Zarr group metadata
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

stacAttributes.description: STAC convention attributes using key-prefixed pattern

stac:encoding.description: REQUIRED. Encoding type for STAC objects. 'attribute' embeds the object directly in attributes. 'link' points to the canonical STAC object at an external location via a STAC Link Object. The experimental 'array' encoding (see README) is not yet covered by this schema.

jsonAttrsEncoding.description: STAC object embedded directly in attributes. This is the authoritative source of truth for the assets it lists.

linkEncoding.description: The STAC object is not embedded. Instead, a STAC Link Object points to the canonical STAC Item or Collection describing this Zarr node, hosted elsewhere (e.g. a STAC API).

stacLink.description: A STAC Link Object identifying the canonical, external location of a STAC Item or Collection.

href.description: REQUIRED. Absolute URL to the canonical STAC Item or Collection. MUST NOT be relative to the Zarr store, since the target lives outside it.

rel.description: Link relation type. Defaults to 'self' when omitted.

type.description: Media type of the target, e.g. 'application/geo+json' for an Item or 'application/json' for a Collection.
